gloss: to shatter; to smash to pieces; to be broken into fragments

definitions.gloss: to shatter; to smash to pieces; to be broken into fragments
definitions.explanation: to shatter; to smash to pieces; to be broken into fragments

definitions.gloss: to be shattered; to be completely destroyed (hopes, dreams, confidence)
definitions.explanation: to be shattered; to be completely destroyed (hopes, dreams, confidence)

examples.japanese: グラスが{落|お}ちて{粉々|こなごな}になった。
{地震|じしん}で{窓|まど}ガラスが{粉々|こなごな}に{砕|くだ}けた。
examples.english: The window glass was smashed to pieces by the earthquake.

examples.japanese: {花瓶|かびん}を{床|ゆか}に{落|お}としたら{粉々|こなごな}になってしまった。
examples.english: I dropped the vase on the floor and it shattered into pieces.

examples.japanese: {夢|ゆめ}が{粉々|こなごな}になった。
{信頼|しんらい}が{粉々|こなごな}に{崩|くず}れた。
{一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい}{築|きず}き{上|あ}げたものが、{一瞬|いっしゅん}で{粉々|こなごな}になってしまった。
examples.english: What I had built up so painstakingly was shattered in an instant.

notes:
Describes something breaking into many small pieces or fragments. The word {粉々|こなごな} (from {粉|こな}, powder) emphasizes that the breaking is thorough and complete. Used both literally for physical objects and figuratively for abstract things like dreams and trust.

USAGE:
- {粉々|こなごな}になる: to shatter (intransitive)
- {粉々|こなごな}にする: to smash to pieces (transitive)
- {粉々|こなごな}に{砕|くだ}ける / {砕|くだ}く: to crush to pieces

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粉々|こなごな}に{割|わ}れる: to break into pieces
- {粉々|こなごな}に{砕|くだ}く: to crush into fragments
- {粉々|こなごな}に{壊|こわ}す: to smash to pieces

SIMILAR WORDS:
- バラバラになる: to fall apart; to come to pieces — implies separating into distinct pieces, while {粉々|こなごな} suggests finer, more complete destruction
- {砕|くだ}ける: to break; to be crushed — the act of breaking apart, while {粉々|こなごな} describes the resulting state of being in fragments
